intended_object: This is a fresh variable picked to avoid the free variables of two other auxiliary terms (`nb095AlphaDummy252 x R` and `nb095AlphaDummy251 x R`). It serves as a dummy name for alpha-renaming in a machine-generated nominal proof certificate, as the docstring says ("Checked nominal proof certificate identified upstream as `nb095_alpha_dummy_258`").
explanation: The body calls `freshVar` on the union of the free-variable sets of two other generated dummy terms. The result is a bound-variable name used inside an automatically generated proof certificate. That is an implementation detail of alpha-conversion in the library's internal syntax. It has no counterpart in the mathematical literature, so there is nothing to check for faithfulness or generality.
